_meta.what: Operator notices that change how a station works for a stretch of time: a vagón or an access closed, services that skip the stop, services moved to another vagón. Each is shown on the station page and in its map popup only while it is in force, and marks the drawn plan to match.
_meta.time: `desde` and `hasta` are instants with their offset. `franja` narrows a notice to a daily window in Bogotá time (UTC-5, no daylight saving): `dias` are the days a window STARTS on (0 Sunday … 6 Saturday), and a window that crosses midnight belongs to the day it starts, so Friday 22:00 to 04:00 runs into Saturday morning.
_meta.fields: `cierra.vagones` are the vagón numbers as printed on the platform signs; `cierra.accesos` names an access by the street its Salida sign prints on the plano (the notice's "acceso norte" at Marly is the Calle 50 block); `omiten` are service códigos that do not stop; `trasladan` maps a closed vagón to the one its services board at instead. `titulo` and `detalle` are shown to the rider as written.
_meta.source_rule: Copied from TransMilenio's own published notice and nothing else: `fuente` names it. A notice with no end date stays until it is removed here, and one whose `hasta` has passed is dropped from the catalog when it is built.
